_comment: @id values (or patterns of them) that the consumer (jvto-web) builds at render time and merges into the same @graph. The offline scan (this checker's default mode) reads only the ekosistem half of that graph, so these resolve live but look dangling here. Mirrors jvto-ekosistem/scripts/validate-schema.mjs lines 20-52 (founder, a literal id) and lines 12-15, 178-190 (PDP #webpage, a route pattern -- the tour catalogue changes constantly, so this is a pattern here too, not a per-route list that would rot the first time someone forgot to update it). Every entry needs a reason and the builder that produces it. Not applied in --live mode: there the full merged graph is visible, and a genuinely dangling id -- including a mistyped one of these -- must still fail. "patterns" entries additionally require "onlyUnderPredicates": an id is only exempt when referenced under one of those predicates, so the same id under any other predicate is still checked for real.

ids.why: Founder Person node, merged into the combined @graph at render time. ekosistem never emits it — mirrors jvto-ekosistem/scripts/validate-schema.mjs loadPeopleIds(), lines 47-52, which carries the identical id with the identical reason.

patterns.builtBy: jvto-web src/app/(website)/tours/from-bali/[slug]/page.tsx and the from-surabaya equivalent (inline WebPage builder)
patterns.why: WebPage node for a tour PDP route. ekosistem deliberately does not emit a WebPage node for these routes (see jvto-ekosistem scripts/lib/build-tourist-trip.mjs, lines 90-102: WebPage/BreadcrumbList/Product/mainEntityOfPage stay locally built in jvto-web). jvto-web builds it inline and merges it into the same combined @graph at render time, so the TouristTrip's mainEntityOfPage edge resolves there. A pattern rather than a per-route id list on purpose — mirrors jvto-ekosistem/scripts/validate-schema.mjs PDP_ROUTE_RE and its checkDanglingReferences exemption (lines 12-15, 178-190), which is itself pattern-based so a new tour package never needs a matching edit here. Scoped to mainEntityOfPage only: this pattern must never swallow a reference to one of these ids under a different predicate, which would be a real dangling/mistyped reference.
